messages.While a chapter plays, the page marks th: While a chapter plays, the page marks the sentence being read and can follow it down the page. Timing is estimated from how long the chapter takes to say, so a long pause or a scene break can put it a sentence off. It never changes the audio.
Words and symbols the voice says wrong. Left: exactly what appears in the text. Right: how it should sound, spelled out (Qui-Gon → Kwai-Gon, ʛ → galleon). Works when the symbol is glued to a number too: 50ʛ and ʛ50,000 both read right.
